sentences.ar: يوم الاتنين، توم ما بده يروح عالمدرسة.
sentences.en: On Monday, Tom did not want to go to school.

sentences.ar: حاول يقنع خالته إنه مريض وما نفع.
sentences.en: He tried to convince his aunt he was ill and it did not work.
On the way, he met Huck Finn.

sentences.ar: هَك كان بلا بيت وبلا مدرسة.
sentences.en: Huck had no home and no school.
All the boys of the town envied him.
Huck was carrying a dead cat.
He said: this cures warts, in the graveyard.
They agreed to meet there at night.
